parts:
See y'all in a bit!

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Noam Ross <noam...@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 30, 2012 at 12:55 PM
Subject: [D-RUG]: DRUG this week: Customizing .Rprofile
To: Davis R Users Group <davi...@googlegroups.com>


Hi all,

This week at at DRUG we will have a presentation from Ryan Peek on customizing your R setup:

I [will] take 15 minutes to discuss how to customize your R startup and use Notepad++ or RStudio.  More specifically, I can discuss how to load sets of functions you may need frequently so they are available, as well as modifying several other options in your "Rprofile.site" file.
 
I think it can also be helpful to discuss how to include a few lines of code in the top of your script to determine what computer you are working on (work, home, laptop, etc) which then sets a root file path, and then makes it easy to load file paths that may be slightly different across computers (I can also mention choose.file()/file.choose() in case folks aren't aware of it's use).


As a reminder, DRUG will on Friday, 10-12 in PES 2005.

Finally, we're looking for more presenters for future weeks!  Some possible topics below:

 - Best code organization practices (style guide)
 - Efficiency in coding - how to speed up your code
 - Version control (git)
 - Bayesian stats in R
 - Spatial analytics in R
 - Genetics/bioinformatics in R
 - Population modeling
 - Producing reports with knitr/sweave
 - Modeling admixture hybridization packages...
 - MCMC and the STAN package
 - Monte Carlo simulations in R
 - Interfacing with other languages (why and when?)
 - Working with LOTS of data more efficiently
 - Cluster computing and parallel processing

--
Check out our R resources at http://www.noamross.net/davis-r-users-group.html
